specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent compositing layer for a fixed-pose modular avatar. Reference images establish soft rounded 3D vinyl-toy material, charcoal hair, warm tan skin and gray shirt. Straight-on orthographic frontal camera at eye level, absolutely symmetric presentation. Match the soft matte sculpted materials and upper-left studio lighting. One isolated object, fully visible with generous transparent padding. Genuine alpha background. No ground plane, no scene, no text, no labels, no watermarks, no floating fragments. Subject: Hatsune Miku-inspired over-ear headphones in charcoal black and teal, without a microphone boom. A smooth U-shaped headband arch across the TOP connects two large compact round padded ear cups, one at each side of the empty head space. Ear cups face forward enough to see their sculpted pads and teal outer shells. Their positions should fit the sides of the reference avatar's head. The inside of the arch and the space between the cups are fully transparent. NO HEAD, no face, no hair, no human. Only the complete headphones, with closed symmetrical connections so one clean silhouette can be extracted. Keep the band thin enough to tuck behind hair; ear cups are distinct foreground objects.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target. Keep the avatar's EXACT same head silhouette, ears, neck, body, gray t-shirt, skin color, proportions, pose, placement, padding, material, lighting and transparent alpha background. Remove ONLY the eyes, eyebrows and mouth, smoothly replacing those regions with the matching softly lit skin surface. The entire face should be completely blank and featureless skin. No eyes, brows, nose, mouth, smile, hair or accessories. Do not change the face shape or body shape. This is a blank base for separately composited facial-expression sprites.

Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 establishes the frontal head-and-shoulders avatar proportions and gray shirt. Image 2 establishes the preferred detailed chunky pixel-art aesthetic. Produce ONE front-facing generic warm-tan pixel-art avatar bust with a short dark spiky hairstyle, rounded friendly head, ears, small neck and gray shirt, but with a COMPLETELY BLANK FEATURELESS FACE: no eyes, no eyebrows, no nose and no mouth, just flat shaded skin in the face area. No hat, no headband, no accessory. Crisp square pixel steps, dark pixel outlines, 2 or 3 shading tones per material, a logical 64x64 pixel character enlarged with sharp nearest-neighbor edges, no blur or smooth gradients. Same compact toy-like head/body ratio as Image 1. Center the entire head-and-shoulders silhouette with generous transparent padding. Genuine transparent alpha outside the character. No labels, no text, no frames, no artifacts. The blank face will receive independent pixel facial-expression sprites.

Use case: stylized-concept. One facial-feature sprite atlas for an interactive avatar expression comparison. Portrait sheet, EXACTLY THREE equal-width columns and SIX equal-height rows, eighteen regularly spaced cells. No visible grid lines. Every cell contains only a matched pair of eyes, eyebrows and a mouth, floating on actual transparent alpha. NO HEADS, NO FACE SILHOUETTES, NO SKIN, NO HAIR, NO NOSE, NO EARS, NO TORSO. Each group centered at identical anchor positions: left eye centered at 32% of cell width, right eye at 68%, eye baseline at 40% of cell height, eyebrows at 24%, mouth centered at 50% width and 76% height. Groups fill the middle 74% of each cell with generous transparent separation. Keep the eye centers and mouth center at the same locations in all eighteen cells. COLUMN 1 uses simple solid black oval toy eyes. COLUMN 2 uses round eyes with white sclera, blue irises and black pupils. COLUMN 3 uses wider almond-shaped anime eyes with blue irises and clearly defined upper lids. The SIX ROWS, top to bottom: 1 friendly smile with relaxed eyes and eyebrows, 2 neutral expression with calm eyes and small straight mouth, 3 joyful laughing with smiling crescent closed eyes and an open laughing mouth, 4 angry/determined with eyebrows angled inward and a small frowning mouth, 5 sleepy with half-closed eyes, drooping lids and a tiny neutral mouth, 6 surprised with widened eyes, raised eyebrows and small open O mouth. The three eye families should remain recognizably different in each row; for the laughing row keep their individual size and lid character even when closed. No text, labels, numbers, frames, background color, checkerboard, shadows outside the facial features or extra objects. Precisely eighteen groups in three columns and six rows, no missing or extra groups. Rendering style: softly sculpted matte 3D vinyl-toy facial features, matching the simple black oval eyes and curved black mouth on the reference avatar. Black eyebrows are sculpted soft raised curved pieces. White eye sclera and blue iris eyes have gentle dimensional shading and restrained highlights. Mouth interiors dark, small white teeth and pink tongue only for the laughing mouths. Features must appear as isolated 3D pieces on transparency, not drawn on a skin patch. Consistent frontal orthographic view and soft lighting, no perspective tilts.
